name: VIBE-Banana-Pro
description: A vision benchmark focused on 3D human pose and motion estimation from video, derived from the VIBE benchmark family. It evaluates models' accuracy in predicting 3D joint positions and temporal consistency across frames, often under challenging real-world motions and occlusions. The suite is intended for assessing both per-frame pose accuracy and tracking/stability over time.
evaluation_method: MPJPE (Mean Per-Joint Position Error); PCK and related pose accuracy metrics often reported
reputation: Part of the VIBE benchmark family and recognized within the human pose estimation community, though more specialized than large general-purpose vision benchmarks.
